The v27 manifest is prepared-unadmitted, so its replay cannot close source evidence.

dependencies: pray.c:godvoice() has no consumed return; js/pray.js:2239-2248 already implements its rn2(4) voice selection and message.
polyself.c:rehumanize() is a void form transition; js/polyself.js:2106-2168 implements the route and calls polyman(). Preserve it before losehp().
hack.c:losehp(rnd(20), ...) consumes rnd(20) as damage; js/hack.js:1273+ implements losehp().

The rnz(250) result updates u.ublesscnt, and the rnl(u.ualign.record) result gates angrygods() in Gehennom; preserve both consumed results and source order.

angrygods() and pleased() are void callees reached by other prayer_done() arms but remain partial in js/pray.js; they are separate source frontiers. UnsupportedPrayerError also remains needed by angrygods() and other prayer code.
